overlaps.detail: Chebotarev Layer 7 builds the auxiliary-prime theorem exists_auxiliaryPrime: q ≡ 1 mod n, unramified in K and L, the cyclotomic polynomial irreducible over K, L ∩ K(ζ_q) = K, and Gal(L·K(ζ_q)/K) ≃ Gal(L/K) × Gal(K(ζ_q)/K) with Frobenius compatibility. CFT Layer 11 proves the reciprocity law "by the cyclotomic crossing argument", Artin's lemma, which needs the same auxiliary primes, linear disjointness and compositum. Neither text names the other, and both constructions avoid reciprocity and density.
overlaps.proposal: Make Chebotarev 7.1–7.4 (auxiliary prime, disjointness, compositum and its Frobenius compatibility) a reciprocity-free milestone that both roadmaps cite, so that CFT Layer 11 states only its own crossing lemma for cyclic extensions on top of it. CFT Layer 10's ban on "Chebotarev" as an input refers to the density theorem, and should say so, so that this shared algebraic lemma stays usable.

overlaps.detail: HigherLocalFields HL.3 constructs reciprocity and the norm-subgroup correspondence for n-local fields. At n = 1 this is CFT Layer 8's local reciprocity and local class-field correspondence. In equal characteristic, HL.2–HL.3 also cover the wild (Artin–Schreier–Witt) case, which CFT §1 explicitly excludes: CFT proves only prime-to-p existence there.
overlaps.proposal: HL.3 takes n = 1 from CFT (Layer 7 artinMap, Layer 8 localClassFieldCorrespondence and its prime-to-p version) through a comparison theorem rather than a second construction. HL.3 is the declared owner of the p-primary equal-characteristic local existence and injectivity that CFT excludes, stated at n = 1 as an extension of CFT's correspondence.

overlaps.detail: HeegnerPointEulerSystems HE.0 constructs the orders O_c = ℤ + cO_K, their Pic groups and "their comparison with the relevant idele-class quotients", and relative CM variants K/F. For quadratic orders over ℚ these are GlobalNumberFields Layer 11 and CFT Layer 13's ringClassIdeleQuotient and ringClassField. CFT Layer 13 asserts ring class fields only when Module.finrank ℚ K = 2, so HE.0's relative CM orders O_F + 𝔠O_K have no supplier.
overlaps.proposal: HE.0 imports GlobalNumberFields orders and Pic and CFT's ringClassIdeleQuotient, ringClassField, ringClassArtinMap and gal_ringClassField_equiv_pic, and keeps only the conductor-change kernels, unit-index bookkeeping and the dihedral action. For CM K/F, either CFT Layer 13 adds relative ring class fields for orders O_F + 𝔠O_K of a quadratic extension K/F, where the congruence description holds relative to O_F, as further applications of globalClassField, or HE.0 builds them explicitly as globalClassField applications and states that it owns them.

CFT Layer 14 proves hilbertProductFormula only for the quadratic symbol (ZMod 2), and calls higher reciprocity follow-on work, although its localSymbol is defined for every n with a primitive root. So the m = 2 case is proved twice and the general case is outside CFT.

overlaps.detail: Both stages state quadratic reciprocity. ClassicalArithmeticCompletion CA.1 integrates the elementary theorem (Mathlib legendreSym, Gauss/Jacobi sums) and records the residue symbols at 2 and at infinite places. CFT Layer 14 derives quadratic reciprocity for ℚ, with the real and dyadic factors, from hilbertProductFormula.

CFT Layer 14's derivation is an application and test of the product formula, and should end in a theorem equating its conclusion with Mathlib's legendreSym.quadratic_reciprocity rather than exporting a second public statement.
